purpose: Controlled local reference contract for FlowMat File -> Transform -> HTTP -> Data acceptance.

scope.businessEffects: Validation and bounded process-local memory only. No provisioning, filesystem write or downstream service call.
scope.fileAndTransform: Existing manually reported File/Transform steps with synthetic JSON fixtures. This contract does not implement file upload, a file reader or automatic transformation.

observedAt.calendarValidation: Must equal Date.toISOString after parsing; invalid calendar dates are rejected.

value.precision: At most 20 integer digits and 9 fractional digits; preserve the string spelling without numeric conversion.

requestValidation.utf8: Fatal decoding; invalid UTF-8 is rejected.
requestValidation.requiredKeys: All keys are required, including note with an explicit null when there is no note.
requestValidation.unknownKeys: Rejected at both root and record levels.
requestValidation.negativeZero: Allowed and retained as a string.
requestValidation.controlCharacters: U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028 and U+2029 are rejected in note.
requestValidation.unicodeScalars: Reject lone high or low surrogates in note. Valid paired Unicode characters are preserved and counted as one.
requestValidation.schemaVersionToken: Use the exact JSON integer token 1. Fractional, decimal and exponent spellings (including 1.0 and 1e0) are rejected before any provider operation; native JSON primitive source prevents rounding a fractional version to 1.

responseShape.result: The validated record fields unchanged, plus accepted:true.

idempotency.sameContent: Validated field values are identical, independent of object key order and JSON whitespace. Decimal string spelling is part of the content.
idempotency.atCapacity: Existing requests remain replayable; a new requestId returns 503.
idempotency.restart: Cache is lost on process restart. This reference does not promise durable provider idempotency.
idempotency.flowMatExecutionRequestId: A separate idempotency identifier passed to FlowMat /execute. It is not injected into this payload; request mapping reads attrs.referenceRequestId.

portContract.nullableNote: Leave note undeclared and optional in the existing FlowMat port schema; the reference API validates null|string. Existing PortSchema does not support nullable string properties.
portContract.inputSide: File/Transform inputs do not have accepted yet. Validate them through requestSchema and requestMapping; do not attach the accepted=true response port contract to those inputs.

allowedHosts: A single RFC1918 IPv4 address assigned to a local network interface
forbiddenHosts: RFC1918 address not owned by this machine
bindPolicy.productionLoopback: Remains blocked by ConnectorTargetPolicy, even when listed in allowed-origins or private-cidrs.
bindPolicy.strictConnectorAcceptance: Requires the owned RFC1918 interface, its exact origin and /32. If none is available, protocol tests can pass but strict connector acceptance remains unverified.

acceptanceChecks: Preview sends no provider request and resolves no credential value.
Owner execution records one committed claim before provider traffic.
The response result is copied to output attrs and the downstream data step input unchanged.
The decimal string and UTC millisecond timestamp are unchanged.
Explicit note:null is not changed to missing.
Replaying the same FlowMat execute requestId does not increase provider traffic.
Provider requestId replay is a separate bounded in-memory contract.
Viewer/editor execution is denied before provider traffic.
Unregistered origins and loopback targets remain blocked by the production policy.
No item, inventory, LOT, BOM, work order or production run is created.
No synthetic token or Authorization value appears in output, events, errors, counts or console logs.

cleanup.provider: Close only the owned server; its cache is process-local and is discarded.
cleanup.flowMat: Use a new disposable project and isolated database; delete only resources created by this acceptance run.
cleanup.processes: Track the owned process handle/PID and command. Never stop unrelated servers or containers.
cleanup.records: No external service cleanup is required because no external service is called.
